name: megascenes-pet-memorial-portrait
description: Remember a pet you lost with a memorial portrait from its photo in your MegaScenes library: in a sunlit meadow, under a rainbow or among the stars, keeping its breed and markings.

interface.shortDescription: Portraits of a pet you lost
interface.longDescription:
Pick a photo of your dog, cat or any animal from your MegaScenes library and choose the scene and the style: a sunlit meadow, a rainbow bridge, among the stars, with soft angel wings, in soft watercolor, oil painting, pastel or photo. Add its name if you like. You get a gentle portrait that keeps its breed, colors and markings, portrait or square.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the portrait needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The portrait opens in the chat and stays in your library next to the photo.

For a print to frame, a keepsake, a card for the family or a post to remember them.

Limitations: one pet photo per portrait, already in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. A name is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
A gentle memorial portrait of your pet
Return the portrait in the chat
defaultPrompt: A memorial portrait of my dog in a sunlit meadow from my latest MegaScenes photo
A soft watercolor of my cat among the stars with the name Luna
My dog Max under a rainbow, as an oil painting

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Make a memorial portrait of the dog in my latest MegaScenes photo in a sunlit meadow. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one pet memorial portrait needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a pet memorial portrait here?
positive.expected_behavior: The pet memorial portrait models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A soft watercolor memorial portrait of the cat in my latest MegaScenes photo among the stars, with the name Luna. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my pet portrait on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my pet portrait to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
